title: Tic-Tac-Toe
subtitle: Interactive browser game with AI opponent
description: A clean, responsive Tic-Tac-Toe game built with modern web technologies. Features an intelligent AI opponent, smooth animations, and a polished UI that works across devices.
problem: Building a satisfying game experience with simple rules requires careful attention to UX — the AI needs to feel challenging but fair, the board state must be immediately clear, and win/draw detection needs to feel instant.
role: Designed and built the complete game including the game logic engine, AI opponent with minimax algorithm, responsive board UI, and score tracking.
approach: Implemented a minimax algorithm for the AI opponent to ensure optimal play. The UI uses CSS Grid for the board layout with smooth transition animations for piece placement and win-line highlights. State management keeps the game logic clean and testable.
hardestDecision: Tuning the AI difficulty — a perfect minimax player is unbeatable, which isn't fun for most users. Added difficulty levels by introducing controlled randomness at lower settings to make the game enjoyable for different skill levels.
outcome: Fully playable game with multiple difficulty levels. Open source on GitHub.
whatIdChange: Would add multiplayer support over WebSocket, implement a move history replay feature, and add sound effects for piece placement and win celebrations.
